Note: MSE units shall be exempted from Experience. 3.0 Financial Qualification 3.3.1 The Minimum Average Annual Turnover* (MAAT) will be taken as Average of the Best Three Financi al Years Turnover out of the Last Five financial years preceding to the year of NIT is published. In c ase the Applicant is in existence for less than five financial years the minimum average annual tur nover shall be average of the turnover of the completed no. of financial years. The Applicant who is in existence for less than one complete financial year shall not be qualified. The MAAT shall not be less than two times of estimated cost. The project related turnover of the tendering compa ny on standalone basis only (excluding its Associate companies /Holding Company) shall be consid ered. Important Note: 1. A Project Related Turnover (without GST) duly issued by a CA along with UDIN shall be submitted by the bidders. 2. Audited Financial Statements (with UDIN) pertaining to the financial years considered for the calculation of MAAT. 3. MSME firms in relevant category registered in UP shall be exempted from Turnover . 4. TENDER BID PART – I (EARNEST MONEY, TECHNICAL COMMERCIAL AND PREQUALIFY ING DETAILS ETC.)
